title: NovoCRF: Globally Normalized De Novo Peptide Sequencing on a Prefix-Mass Lattice
abstract: arXiv:2611.05260v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: De novo peptide sequencing has moved from dynamic programming over hand-designed or generative scores to large transformers that learn the task end to end. We present NovoCRF, a conditional random field (CRF) whose states are prefix masses, so that its paths are exactly the peptides within $\pm$0.06 Da of the precursor mass. A small network scores each edge from physics-derived ion-match features and is trained with its scores globally normalized over all mass-feasible peptides. To our knowledge, NovoCRF is the first de novo method trained with exact normalization over all mass-feasible peptides. Our model has 3.6M parameters and trains in about 27 GPU-hours. Because it is small, NovoCRF can also adapt to each run at inference time: it fine-tunes part of its weights on the run's own confident answers, recalibrates the run's precursor and fragment masses, and uses retention time, predicted with a pretrained indexed-retention-time mode

translated_title: NovoCRF：基于前缀质量格的全局归一化从头肽段测序
translated_abstract: 从头肽段测序已经从基于手工设计或生成式评分的动态规划方法，发展到端到端学习该任务的大型Transformer模型。我们提出了NovoCRF，一种条件随机场（CRF），其状态为前缀质量，使其路径恰好对应前体质量±0.06 Da范围内的所有肽段。一个小型网络根据源自物理原理的离子匹配特征为每条边评分，并在所有质量可行的肽段上以全局归一化的评分进行训练。据我们所知，NovoCRF是首个在所有质量可行肽段上进行精确归一化训练的从头测序方法。我们的模型仅有360万个参数，训练约需27 GPU小时。由于其模型规模小，NovoCRF还可以在推理时针对每次实验运行进行自适应：它在实验自身的高置信度预测结果上微调部分权重，重新校准该实验的前体质量和碎片质量，并利用预训练的保留时间索引模型预测的保留时间信息。
tldr: NovoCRF首次提出在所有质量可行肽段上以精确全局归一化方式训练的条件随机场模型，通过前缀质量格约束路径实现从头肽段测序，模型仅360万参数、训练约27 GPU小时，并可在推理时针对每次实验自适应微调。
en_tdlr: NovoCRF is the first de novo peptide sequencing method trained with exact global normalization over all mass-feasible peptides, using a CRF on a prefix-mass lattice with only 3.6M parameters that can adapt to each LC-MS/MS run at inference time.
